meta.name: do
meta.description: Execute a phased implementation plan using subagents. Use when asked to execute, run, or carry out a plan — especially one created by make-plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用子智能体自动执行分阶段计划
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果已有分步计划需要自动执行
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a step-by-step plan to execute automatically

howto.what: 安装后，当要求执行计划时，Claude 会作为协调者，将任务按阶段拆分并派出多个子代理分别执行实现、验证、反模式检查、代码质量审查与提交；它自己只负责协调和确认，不直接做具体实现。
howto.when: 当用户要求执行、运行或实施一个计划时触发，尤其是由 make-plan 生成的计划。

say.note: Claude 会作为协调者，派出子代理分阶段执行。

say.text: 运行这个实施计划，每个阶段都要验证
say.note: 它会在每阶段后部署验证子代理并检查。

say.text: 按照 make-plan 生成的方案开始实施
say.note: 该技能会按步骤拆分给子代理，并在验证通过后提交。

howto.what_en: When asked to execute a plan, Claude orchestrates: splits work into phases, dispatches subagents to implement, verify, check anti-patterns, review code, and commit only when verified; it doesn't do the work itself.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to execute, run, or carry out a plan, especially one created by make-plan.

say_en.note: Claude delegates to subagents in phases.

say_en.text: Run this implementation plan, verify each phase
say_en.note: It deploys verification subagents after each phase.

say_en.text: Start implementing the plan created by make-plan
say_en.note: It splits steps among subagents and commits only after verification.
